scope: Actual Chromium renderer fixture; software WebGL, no hardware FPS claim. Visibility is simulated with document.hidden; offscreen suspension uses actual intersection/scroll.
checks: camera controls wake at rest without recalculating shadows
keyboard movement, key release and camera settling remain active
identical physical scenes reuse their environment while refreshing choices
changed physical staging replaces the environment
all current profiles publish exact offered targets, cast and props
pointer walk and nearby E keep current proximity interaction
label changes refresh targets without rebuilding physical staging
disabling while moving stops movement and rejects E
offscreen progression updates logical metadata and builds only the final visible stage
visibility suspension retains a pending camera wake
unmount cleans canvas, pending frames, observers and external listeners; remount works
